Right moves focus to Continue…. Enter opens the dialog whose title ends with · gate 2 of 2 and whose phrase, read from the screen, is TRASH 6 UNDER /Users/alex ON mbp. Typing TRASH 0 and Enter paints Does not match and does not start cleanup. Clearing the field, typing that phrase, and Enter paints cleanup started · 6 items · quitting waits for it. The title is first Cleanup running. Its Outcome contains running ·, of 6 items, and quitting waits for the rest, and the Bytes fact still contains 0 B freed now. When the job finishes the title is Cleanup report, the summary is 6 trashed, Mode is trash, the log fact is ~/.cache/holla/ops.log · every record written, and the Bytes fact is 2.1 GiB left the tree · 0 B freed now · the rest returns when the Trash is emptied.
